module security.passwords
  purpose: Classify password strength.

public type PasswordStrength is one of
  purpose: The strength category assigned to a password.
  Weak
  Fair
  Strong
end

public function classify_password(password: Text) returns PasswordStrength
  purpose: Classify a password as Weak, Fair, or Strong.
  example: classify_password("short7!") is Weak
  example: classify_password("longpass") is Fair
  example: classify_password("LongPassword7!") is Strong

  let has_letter be for each character in password.characters() any character.matches(raw "[A-Za-z]")
  let has_digit be for each character in password.characters() any character.matches(raw "[0-9]")
  let has_other be for each character in password.characters() any not character.matches(raw "[A-Za-z0-9]")

  if password.length() is at least 12 and has_letter and has_digit and has_other then
    return Strong
  otherwise if password.length() is at least 8 then
    return Fair
  otherwise
    return Weak
  end
end

module password.strength
  purpose: Classify passwords by simple strength rules.

public type PasswordStrength is one of
  purpose: The strength category assigned to a password.
  Weak
  Fair
  Strong
end

public function classify_password(password: Text) returns PasswordStrength
  purpose: Classify a password as Weak, Fair or Strong.
  example: classify_password("short") is Weak
  example: classify_password("longer99") is Fair
  example: classify_password("LongPassword9!") is Strong

  let has_letter be password.matches(raw ".*[A-Za-z].*")
  let has_digit be password.matches(raw ".*[0-9].*")
  let has_other_kind be password.matches(raw ".*[^A-Za-z0-9].*")

  if password.length() is at least 12 and has_letter and has_digit and has_other_kind then
    return Strong
  otherwise if password.length() is at least 8 then
    return Fair
  otherwise
    return Weak
  end
end

module security.passwords
  purpose: Classify passwords by simple strength rules.

public type PasswordStrength is one of
  purpose: The strength category assigned to a password.
  Weak
  Fair
  Strong
end

public function classify_password(password: Text) returns PasswordStrength
  purpose: Classify a password as Weak, Fair, or Strong.
  example: classify_password(password: "short") is Weak
  example: classify_password(password: "abcdefgh") is Fair
  example: classify_password(password: "abc123!@#def") is Strong

  if is_strong_password(password) then
    return Strong
  otherwise if password.length is at least 8 then
    return Fair
  otherwise
    return Weak
  end
end

function is_strong_password(password: Text) returns Boolean
  purpose: Decide whether a password meets the Strong rule.
  example: is_strong_password(password: "abc123!@#def") is true

  return password.length is at least 12 and has_letter(password) and has_digit(password) and has_other_character(password)
end

function has_letter(password: Text) returns Boolean
  purpose: Decide whether text contains an ASCII letter.
  example: has_letter(password: "123a") is true

  return password.matches(raw ".*[A-Za-z].*")
end

function has_digit(password: Text) returns Boolean
  purpose: Decide whether text contains an ASCII digit.
  example: has_digit(password: "abc1") is true

  return password.matches(raw ".*[0-9].*")
end

function has_other_character(password: Text) returns Boolean
  purpose: Decide whether text contains a character that is not an ASCII letter or digit.
  example: has_other_character(password: "abc!") is true

  return password.matches(raw ".*[^A-Za-z0-9].*")
end

module passwords.strength
  purpose: Classify passwords by simple strength rules.

public type PasswordStrength is one of
  purpose: The strength assigned to a password.
  Weak
  Fair
  Strong
end

public function classify_password(password: Text) returns PasswordStrength
  purpose: Classify a password as Weak, Fair or Strong.
  example: classify_password("short") is Weak
  example: classify_password("longenough") is Fair
  example: classify_password("LongEnough12!") is Strong

  let has_letter be for each character in password.characters() any character.matches(raw "^[A-Za-z]$")
  let has_digit be for each character in password.characters() any character.matches(raw "^[0-9]$")
  let has_other_kind be for each character in password.characters() any not character.matches(raw "^[A-Za-z]$") and not character.matches(raw "^[0-9]$")

  if password.length() is at least 12 and has_letter and has_digit and has_other_kind then
    return Strong
  otherwise if password.length() is at least 8 then
    return Fair
  otherwise
    return Weak
  end
end
